items.title: Generative-Enhanced Ensemble Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading under Severe Class Imbalance
items.organization: ELITE Research Lab LLC, New York
items.description: Developed a dual-head architecture combining ordinal regression with categorical classification for seven-stage diabetic retinopathy grading. The framework utilizes Stable Diffusion 2.1 generative augmentation with ControlNet-Canny conditioning and morphological attention masks for addressing severe class imbalance in medical imaging datasets.
items.contributions:
Designed dual-head neural architecture integrating ordinal regression and categorical classification
Achieved 91.65% accuracy for seven-stage diabetic retinopathy classification
Implemented stacking ensemble combining five CNN architectures improving baseline accuracy by 2.09%
Applied explainable AI techniques using Grad-CAM++ for model interpretability and clinical validation
Achieved 91.67% macro F1-score demonstrating robust performance across imbalanced classes
items.tech_tags: PyTorch, Stable Diffusion 2.1, ControlNet, CNN Ensemble, Grad-CAM++, Medical Imaging, XAI

items.title: Developing an Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for Real-Time Detection of Malicious Network Traffic in Bangladesh
items.description: Contributed to developing an adaptive machine learning framework for detecting malicious network traffic using real-time data from Bangladesh telecommunications infrastructure. The project focused on creating robust detection mechanisms for various network-based security threats.
items.contributions:
Collected and preprocessed large-scale real-time network traffic dataset from Bangladesh telecommunications infrastructure
Collaborated with research team on deep learning model development and optimization
Conducted literature review on network security and intrusion detection systems
Supported experiment environment setup and data pipeline development
Contributed to academic writing and technical documentation
items.tech_tags: Deep Learning, Network Security, Data Preprocessing, Python, Literature Review

items.title: Attentive TabNet Framework for Multiclass Intrusion Detection in IoMT
items.description: Developed an advanced intrusion detection system for Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) environments using TabNet architecture with attention mechanisms. The framework incorporates GAN-based synthetic data generation to address class imbalance challenges in cybersecurity applications.
items.contributions:
Developed TabNet-based framework with attention mechanisms for IoMT intrusion detection
Implemented GAN-based synthetic data generation to address severe class imbalance
Achieved 97.96% multiclass accuracy across 89 million network traffic records
Designed feature engineering pipeline for network traffic analysis
Validated framework performance on large-scale real-world IoMT datasets
items.tech_tags: TabNet, GANs, Attention Mechanism, IoMT Security, Deep Learning, Intrusion Detection

items.title: A Deep Learning-Based Framework for Bangla Vehicle License Plate Detection and Recognition
items.description: Developed a deep learning framework for Bangla vehicle license plate text recognition using image restoration and sequence recognition techniques. The system addresses challenges specific to Bangla character recognition in license plate detection.
items.contributions:
Designed end-to-end framework for Bangla license plate detection and recognition
Implemented image restoration techniques for enhancing license plate quality
Achieved 96% character-level accuracy on synthetic Bangla license plate dataset
Developed sequence recognition pipeline for text extraction
Published findings in Springer CCIS proceedings
items.tech_tags: Deep Learning, Computer Vision, OCR, Image Processing, Python
